items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: So the guys just took Joe and put him on the bandstand... I didn't know these guys at all.

ctx.x: But in person it was just a different thing. And then another time I ran into the band men, they were -- this was when Jimmy Blanton and Ben Webster and that particular band. They were in the band at that point. And so Joe Louis, the fighter, was in his prime, in his heyday. So the guys just took Joe and put him on the bandstand, and he

sat there all the way through the concert and I finally wormed my way in, some kind of way, to sit near the band. I didn't know these guys at all. Never thought I would even meet them, you know. I just sat there by the railing, and --
